fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after arrival and have at least 2 blank pages.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe caducar al menos 6 meses después de la llegada y tener al menos 2 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you arrive and have at least 2 blank pages.

entry.en: You must register at a local police station if you are in South Sudan for 5 days or more.
entry.es: Debes registrarte en una comisaría local si permaneces en Sudán del Sur 5 días o más.
entry.quote: You must register at a local police station if you’re in South Sudan for 5 days or more.

entry.en: You must have a certificate proving a yellow fever vaccination to enter.
entry.es: Debes tener un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla para entrar.
entry.quote: To enter South Sudan, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination.

entry.en: Security services have harassed, detained and expelled foreign nationals at Juba airport, often over vaccine proof, visas and work permits.
entry.es: Los servicios de seguridad han acosado, detenido y expulsado a extranjeros en el aeropuerto de Juba, a menudo por la prueba de vacunación, visados y permisos de trabajo.
entry.quote: South Sudan’s security services have harassed, detained and expelled foreign nationals, including non-governmental organisation staff and journalists, when they enter or leave Juba airport.

entry.en: At land borders from DRC or Uganda you may encounter health screening such as temperature checks.
entry.es: En las fronteras terrestres con RDC o Uganda puedes encontrar controles sanitarios como toma de temperatura.
entry.quote: If crossing a land border from DRC or Uganda into South Sudan, you may encounter health screening measures such as temperature checks and a request to provide a brief travel history.

entry.en: Some airlines ask passengers departing Juba to complete a health declaration form.
entry.es: Algunas aerolíneas piden a los pasajeros que salen de Juba rellenar un formulario de declaración de salud.
entry.quote: At Juba International Airport, some airlines are now asking passengers departing the country to complete a health declaration form.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to South Sudan due to the risk of armed violence and criminality.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a Sudán del Sur por el riesgo de violencia armada y criminalidad.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to South Sudan due to the risk of armed violence and criminality.

safety.en: There is a high risk of serious crime such as robbery and assault in Juba and other urban areas, particularly at night and on public transport.
safety.es: Hay un alto riesgo de delitos graves como robo y agresión en Juba y otras zonas urbanas, sobre todo de noche y en transporte público.
safety.quote: There is a high risk of serious crime such as robbery and assault in Juba and other urban areas, particularly at night and on public transport.

safety.en: Armed men at checkpoints have been known to demand money from drivers and abuse people, especially women.
safety.es: Se sabe que hombres armados en los controles exigen dinero a conductores y maltratan a la gente, sobre todo a mujeres.
safety.quote: Armed men at checkpoints have been known to demand money from drivers and abuse people, especially women.

safety.en: There is a risk from landmines or unexploded cluster bombs in some areas.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de minas terrestres o bombas de racimo sin explotar en algunas zonas.
safety.quote: There is a risk from landmines or unexploded cluster bombs in some areas of South Sudan.

safety.en: Sex between men is illegal and punishable by up to 14 years in prison.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre hombres es ilegal y se castiga con hasta 14 años de prisión.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity between men is illegal and punishable by a prison sentence of up to 14 years.

safety.en: Do not photograph government buildings, military installations, bridges, airports, public utilities and other sensitive areas.
safety.es: No fotografíes edificios gubernamentales, instalaciones militares, puentes, aeropuertos, servicios públicos ni otras zonas sensibles.
safety.quote: Do not take photographs close to government buildings, military installations, bridges, airports, public utilities (including petrol stations) and other sensitive areas.

health.en: South Sudan does not have an emergency medical public phone number.
health.es: Sudán del Sur no tiene un número público de emergencias médicas.
health.quote: South Sudan does not have an emergency medical public phone number.

health.en: The risk of malaria in South Sudan is high.
health.es: El riesgo de malaria en Sudán del Sur es alto.
health.quote: The risk of malaria in South Sudan is high.

health.en: Health facilities are extremely limited throughout South Sudan.
health.es: Los centros de salud son extremadamente limitados en todo Sudán del Sur.
health.quote: Health facilities are extremely limited throughout South Sudan.

health.en: Many medical issues require evacuation to neighbouring hubs, most commonly Nairobi and Kampala.
health.es: Muchos problemas médicos requieren evacuación a centros vecinos, sobre todo Nairobi y Kampala.
health.quote: Many medical issues require medical evacuation to neighbouring hubs (Nairobi, Kenya, and Kampala, Uganda, are the most common).

health.en: Most South Sudanese drink river water, which exposes them to diarrhea and cholera.
health.es: La mayoría de los sursudaneses beben agua de río, lo que los expone a diarrea y cólera.
health.quote: Most of the South Sudanese drink water from the rivers, which exposes them to diarrhea and cholera.

health.en: Sleep under a mosquito net and use mosquito repellent.
health.es: Duerme bajo mosquitero y usa repelente de mosquitos.
health.quote: Be sure to sleep under a mosquito net and use mosquito repellent.

help.en: There are no central emergency numbers in South Sudan.
help.es: No hay números centrales de emergencia en Sudán del Sur.
help.quote: There are no central emergency numbers in South Sudan.

help.en: The British Embassy in Juba has no consular section, so urgent UK help is sought from the High Commission in Nairobi.
help.es: La Embajada británica en Juba no tiene sección consular; la ayuda urgente del Reino Unido se pide en el Alto Comisionado en Nairobi.
help.quote: The British Embassy in Juba does not have a consular section. If you are in South Sudan and need urgent help from the UK government, contact the British High Commission in Nairobi, Kenya.

getting_in.en: As of 2025, the only direct commercial flights from outside Africa were from Dubai and Istanbul, the latter suspended in May 2026.
getting_in.es: En 2025, los únicos vuelos comerciales directos desde fuera de África eran desde Dubái y Estambul, este último suspendido en mayo de 2026.
getting_in.quote: As of 2025, the only direct commercial flights from outside Africa are from Dubai on flydubai and Istanbul with Turkish Airlines (suspended May 2026).

getting_in.en: Most airlines flying into Juba depart from Cairo, Addis Ababa, Entebbe, Nairobi and Khartoum.
getting_in.es: La mayoría de las aerolíneas a Juba salen de El Cairo, Adís Abeba, Entebbe, Nairobi y Jartum.
getting_in.quote: Most airlines flying into Juba depart from Cairo (Egypt), Addis Ababa (Ethiopia), Entebbe (Uganda), Nairobi (Kenya) and Khartoum (Sudan).

getting_in.en: As of April 2024, crossing from Uganda to South Sudan is possible.
getting_in.es: En abril de 2024, es posible cruzar de Uganda a Sudán del Sur.
getting_in.quote: As of April 2024, crossing from Uganda to South Sudan is possible.

getting_in.en: A bus can be taken from Kampala to Juba.
getting_in.es: Se puede tomar un autobús de Kampala a Juba.
getting_in.quote: A bus can be taken from Kampala to Juba.

getting_in.en: As of 2014 there were no scheduled passenger rail services.
getting_in.es: En 2014 no había servicios ferroviarios regulares de pasajeros.
getting_in.quote: As of 2014, however, there are no scheduled passenger services

getting_in.en: If security deteriorates, routes into and out of South Sudan may be blocked.
getting_in.es: Si la seguridad empeora, las rutas de entrada y salida de Sudán del Sur podrían bloquearse.
getting_in.quote: If the unstable security situation deteriorates, routes into and out of South Sudan may be blocked.

getting_around.en: Roads are unpaved and often become impassable in the rainy season.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras no están asfaltadas y a menudo se vuelven intransitables en la temporada de lluvias.
getting_around.quote: Roads are unpaved, and during the rainy season from July to October and November, they often become impassable.

getting_around.en: Very few roads are surfaced and maintained, particularly outside Juba.
getting_around.es: Muy pocas carreteras están asfaltadas y mantenidas, sobre todo fuera de Juba.
getting_around.quote: Very few roads are surfaced and maintained, particularly outside Juba.

getting_around.en: Public transport, including motorbike taxis, is described as extremely unsafe.
getting_around.es: El transporte público, incluidos los mototaxis, se describe como extremadamente inseguro.
getting_around.quote: Public transport, including small buses, vans and motorbike taxis (‘boda-bodas’), is extremely unsafe.

money.en: The currency is the South Sudanese pound (SSP).
money.es: La moneda es la libra sursudanesa (SSP).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the South Sudanese pound (ISO currency code: SSP).

money.en: International credit and debit cards are not widely accepted.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito y débito internacionales no se aceptan ampliamente.
money.quote: International credit and debit cards are not widely accepted, although some of the newer hotels and supermarkets are starting to.

money.en: ATMs are hard to find and often cannot be used with international cards.
money.es: Los cajeros son difíciles de encontrar y a menudo no funcionan con tarjetas internacionales.
money.quote: ATMs are hard to find, and it is often not possible to use international cards.

money.en: Bring large-denomination, clean US dollar notes dated 2017 onwards.
money.es: Lleva billetes de dólares estadounidenses de alta denominación, limpios y de 2017 en adelante.
money.quote: Bring large denomination US dollars (clean, unblemished notes dated 2017 onwards).

money.en: You can withdraw money with Visa or MasterCard at Ecobank or Equity bank ATMs.
money.es: Puedes retirar dinero con Visa o MasterCard en cajeros de Ecobank o Equity bank.
money.quote: You can withdraw money with a Visa or MasterCard credit/debit card in any of the Ecobank or Equity bank ATMs in South Sudan.

money.en: Money changers line some streets with stacks of SSP, but be wary of them.
money.es: Hay cambistas en algunas calles con fajos de SSP, pero hay que desconfiar de ellos.
money.quote: There are also money changers that line some streets with stacks of SSPs but be wary of them.

connectivity.en: Roaming with foreign phones or SIM cards does not usually work in South Sudan.
connectivity.es: El roaming con teléfonos o SIM extranjeras no suele funcionar en Sudán del Sur.
connectivity.quote: Roaming with foreign phones/SIM cards does not usually work in South Sudan.

connectivity.en: You need to buy a SIM card from a local network (Zain or MTN) and bring an unlocked phone.
connectivity.es: Necesitas comprar una SIM de una red local (Zain o MTN) y llevar un teléfono desbloqueado.
connectivity.quote: you will need to purchase a SIM card from one of the local networks (Zain or MTN). Bring an unlocked phone.

connectivity.en: The telephone country code for South Sudan is +211.
connectivity.es: El prefijo telefónico de Sudán del Sur es +211.
connectivity.quote: Telephone country code for South Sudan is +211
